Allocation of Points for Permission Examination Criteria (Re: Article 2(4))
■ Enforcement Decree of Internet Multimedia Broadcast Services Act [Appendix 1]

Allocation of Points for Permission Examination Criteria (Re: Article 2(4))

| Examination criterion | Points |
| --- | ---: |
| 1. Feasibility of fulfilling the public responsibility, fairness, and public interest of broadcasting | 80 |
| 2. Appropriateness of the plan for procuring and supplying content, and contribution to the development of the broadcast and audiovisual industry | 100 |
| 3. Appropriateness of the plan to secure fair competition in the pay broadcasting market | 80 |
| 4. Appropriateness of the management plan, including organizational and personnel management | 80 |
| 5. Financial capability | 80 |
| 6. Technical capability and appropriateness of the facilities plan | 80 |
| Total | 500 |
